Subject: Clarification on the Document Review Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to clarify the document review process that we follow to ensure the accuracy and completeness of our project documents.

When a document is ready for review, it will be circulated to all relevant team members. Each reviewer is expected to provide their feedback within three working days of receiving the document. Please note that all comments should be detailed and specific to enable effective revisions. 

If any reviewer has any questions or concerns about the document, they should feel free to reach out to me directly. I am here to assist and ensure that we address all issues in a timely manner.

Your input is crucial in improving the quality of our deliverables, and I appreciate your attention to this matter. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you need any further clarification or if you have any suggestions
